content_fields.title: Prevent path environment attacks (Bash/Shell)
content_fields.description: Set an explicit PATH and invoke external commands by absolute path.
content_fields.finding: Commands are invoked by bare name, so resolution depends on the inherited PATH.
content_fields.required_fix:
#!/bin/bash
# start_app.sh
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
readonly PATH

/usr/bin/mkdir -m 0750 -p postgres_data
/usr/local/bin/docker compose up "$@"
criteria: PATH is assigned explicitly and marked readonly before any command runs.
External binaries are invoked by absolute path.
